meta.title: Words — a word game without ads
meta.description: Make words from the letters on the wheel and fill the crossword. No ads, no accounts, no tracking; works offline.

home.wheelNote: Make words from the letters on the wheel and fill the crossword.
home.fieldNote: The whole field splits into words — find them all.

game.loadFailed: The word list could not be loaded. Check the connection and open the game again.
game.tipBoth: Swipe across the letters to make a word — or tap them one by one, then “Check”.
game.tipSwipe: Swipe across the letters to make a word; lift your finger to check it.
game.tipTap: Tap the letters one by one, then “Check”.
game.bonus: Bonus word: {word} — a real word, not in this crossword

field.tipBoth: Swipe across a word’s letters from the first to the last — or tap them one by one, then “Check”.
field.tipSwipe: Swipe across a word’s letters from the first to the last; let go and the word is checked.
field.tipTap: Tap a word’s letters one by one, then “Check”.
field.stuck: {word} is a real word, but with it the rest of the field cannot be filled. It counts as a bonus word.
field.notOnField: {word}: there is no such path on the field
field.label: Word Field
field.howToType: Type a word from the field and press Enter. Taken cells are shown as dashes.

hint.title: Hint
hint.chooseCell: Letter in a cell you choose
hint.chooseNow: Tap a cell of the crossword that is still empty.
hint.counted: Every hint is free; the result shows how many were used.

bonusList.title: Bonus words
bonusList.none: No bonus words yet. Real words made of these letters that are not in the crossword are kept here.

meaning.title: Meaning
meaning.none: No description of this word yet.

streak.one: Daily puzzles: {n} day in a row
streak.other: Daily puzzles: {n} days in a row

settings.title: Settings
settings.showCells: Show the empty cells of the crossword
settings.showLeft: Show how many words are left
settings.grace: Keep the streak after one missed day
settings.huTiles: Hungarian: cs, gy, ly, ny, sz, ty, zs as one tile
settings.installIos: On iPhone or iPad: tap “Share”, then add the game to the Home Screen.
settings.resetSure: Tap again to clear levels, statistics and saved games

reported.title: Reported words
reported.none: No words reported yet. If a word looks wrong, tap “Report” after trying it.
reported.note: The list stays on this device. Copy it and send it to us if you like — the game sends nothing itself.

about.title: About the game

rules.one: Make words from the letters on the wheel: each letter once in a word, at least {n} letter. A word of the crossword fills its cells; the level is done when the crossword is full. Other real words made of the letters count as bonus words.
rules.other: Make words from the letters on the wheel: each letter once in a word, at least {n} letters. A word of the crossword fills its cells; the level is done when the crossword is full. Other real words made of the letters count as bonus words.

about.forms: English: the crossword holds common words in their dictionary form; plurals and other forms count as bonus words.
about.text: A word game without ads, accounts or tracking. Progress stays on this device. Works offline.
about.keys: Keyboard: letters — make a word, Enter — check, Backspace — last letter off, Space — shuffle, ? — hint, Esc — close.
about.dictionariesNote: The word lists come from these sources (their authors and licences):
about.licence: The full text of the GNU LGPL 2.1 licence
about.fieldRules: Word Field: the whole field splits into hidden words; a word goes through neighbouring cells up, down, left or right, never diagonally. Another real word counts too if the rest of the field can still be filled with words.
about.meanings: Tap a found word in the crossword to see what it means. For now, the words of levels 1–{n} have descriptions.
